note: fw-manifest-join-01: reviewed joins between a DECLARED set and a WIRED set,
both keyed by name. scripts/check_manifest_join.py checks each in both
directions and fails closed. An empty joins list is refused, so this file
carries the one join DevGate ships as the project baseline.
test-suite-floor: DevGate's own test suites stay paired with their
tests/expected-counts.json floor rows. This repo has no python test suites
of its own under those names, so the join is scoped to .devgate/tests and
stays meaningful for the embedded framework checkout.

joins.reason: Every collected test suite must carry a floor row, or it can shrink to zero silently: gen_floors only iterates rows that already exist, so a suite with no row is never compared to anything. This is the floor half of fw-floor-01 for the embedded DevGate suites.
